info.name: Akai MPK mini - FX Station
info.author: Mixxx Android
info.description: The FX Station from the pads and knobs of an Akai MPK mini (MK2 or MK3), keyboard at its default octave. Top pads: kick, snare, clap, hi-hat (select and play). Bottom pads: roll 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 while held. Knobs: 1 Scene amount (0 = off), 2 time, 3 feedback, 4 which Scene, 5-7 Isolate low, mid, high, 8 X-Pad level. Factory settings, any MIDI channel (pads notes 36-43 or PROG CHANGE 0-7, knobs CC 1-8 or 70-77).
